#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

bool match(const string& s, int n) {
    int x = -1;
    int len = s.length();
    for (int i = len - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        int d = n % 10;
        if (s[i] == 'X') {
            if (x >= 0 && x != d) {
                return false;
            }
            x = d;
        } else if (s[i] != '_') {
            if (s[i] - '0' != d) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        if (len > 1 && i == 0 && d == 0) {
            return false;
        }
        n /= 10;
    }
    return true;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    int end = 1;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
        end *= 10;
    }
    int res = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < end; i += 25) {
        if (match(s, i)) {
            res++;
        }
    }
    cout << res << "\n";
    return 0;
}
